svg.title: A clear task, written as a brief
svg.desc: Five rows pairing each part of a brief with a book-summary example: goal, context, constraints, done when (checkable asserts), and how judgment calls get checked (a short rubric).

g.text: A clear task, written as a brief
Goal first, then only what serves it, then a finish line you can test.
Summarize the themes of chapters 3 to 5
The chapters themselves, not a page of reviews
Plain English, for a book club slide
Each theme under 400 characters, every listed quote included
Score the tone against two example summaries
